Callout.Name: Motorcycle Collision
Callout.Message: Motorcyclist down, driver of the other vehicle on scene.
Callout.Advisory: Rider conscious, leg injured, lane blocked.

Script.Line: I am all right. I am all right. Is the bike all right?
He pulled out in front of me. He did not look.
I have got a cut on my arm. Nothing else. I am fine.

Callout.Patient: I am all right. I am all right. Is the bike all right?

Lines.Approach: Rider is down and conscious, and the car driver is standing there not knowing what to do.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
